rules.description: C. trav. L3141-3: 2.5 jours ouvrables per month of actual work, 30 jours ouvrables (5 weeks) per full year

source.title: Service-Public.fr: Congés payés du salarié dans le secteur privé (C. trav. L3141-3 s.)

versions.notes: Service-Public (vérifié le 30 avril 2026): 2,5 jours ouvrables par mois de travail effectif chez le même employeur; 30 jours ouvrables (5 semaines) pour une année complète; employer may count in jours ouvrés provided the result is at least equal. 25 jours ouvrés is the 5-day-week equivalent of 5 weeks. Verified as the law in force on the verification date; historical effective date not researched, so effectiveFrom is set to 2026-01-01 (earlier dates resolve to the parent/none).

rules.description: Sickness: social security daily allowance (IJSS, 3 waiting days, 50% of daily basic wage) plus employer complement after 1 year of service (7 waiting days; 90% then 66.66% by seniority band)

source.title: Service-Public.fr: Arrêt maladie – indemnités journalières et complément employeur (CSS; C. trav. L1226-1, D1226-1 à D1226-8)

versions.notes: Service-Public F3053 (vérifié le 1 juin 2026): IJ = 50 % du salaire journalier de base after a 3-day délai de carence per stoppage; employer complement (C. trav. L1226-1, L1226-1-1, D1226-1 à D1226-8) after 1 year of service, 7-day waiting period (none for work accident/occupational disease), 90% then 66.66% of gross pay less IJ, durations 30+30 days (1-5 yrs) rising by 10+10 per 5-year band to 90+90 (31+ yrs). IJ eligibility hours/contribution thresholds and the IJ daily cap (page showed EUR 42.97 gross) are not modelled because their effective dates were not verified. Verified as the law in force on the verification date; historical effective date not researched, so effectiveFrom is set to 2026-01-01 (earlier dates resolve to the parent/none).

value.law: Projet de loi n° 944 (2025-2026) portant transposition de la directive (UE) 2023/970 — filed in the Senate 10 September 2026, accelerated procedure

source.title: EUR-Lex: national transposition measures communicated for Directive (EU) 2023/970

versions.notes: EUR-Lex lists no notified French transposition measures (checked 2026-10-18). Draft status verified on the Senate legislative file https://www.senat.fr/dossier-legislatif/pjl25-944.html (first reading in the Senate, no vote recorded as of the page update on 8 October 2026) — senat.fr is not on the validator allow-list. The bill would replace the index égalité with pay indicators for employers with 50+ employees (per Senate text; not modelled).
